name: Aya Boumezbeur
titleLine: AI Security & Privacy Researcher | Cybersecurity Engineer | Machine Learning and NLP
education: M.Sc. Cybersecurity · Université Ferhat Abbas Sétif 1 · 2025
valueProposition: I research how to make language models safe to use with sensitive data. My work on privacy-preserving clinical AI sits on top of a cybersecurity, networks and systems background.
availability: Open to research collaborations, internships and relevant roles, in Algeria or remote.
bio: I hold a Master's degree in Cybersecurity (2025) and a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (2023), both from Université Ferhat Abbas Sétif 1 in Algeria. My research focuses on the security and privacy of large language models, especially in critical domains such as healthcare.

My Master's thesis project, SecureMed-LLM, explores a layered privacy-preserving framework for clinical report generation. I am the second author of a Springer conference paper reviewing privacy safeguards for LLMs, and I am interested in NLP for low-resource Arabic dialects.

Before research, I spent a year teaching computer science at middle-school level (2025–2026), which shaped how I explain technical ideas. My hands-on base is Linux, networking and vulnerability assessment.
